lesson.uz:
Tashqi For qatorlar, ichki For shu qatordagi elementlar uchun ishlaydi. Har ikki siklning hisoblagichi alohida: i va j. r qator va c ustun uchun ichki amal r*c marta bajariladi.
Jadval ma’lumotlarini qatorma-qator kiriting. Har qator yig‘indisi kerak bo‘lsa s=0 ni tashqi sikl ichida, ichki sikldan oldin yozing. Umumiy yig‘indi uchun esa ikkala sikldan oldin.
lesson.en:
The outer For visits rows and the inner For visits items within each row. Use separate counters i and j. With r rows and c columns, the inner action runs r*c times.
Read data row by row. Reset a row total inside the outer loop before entering the inner loop. Initialize a grand total before both loops.
